text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the final day of summer training 
camp—just as I was getting ready for my 
routine morning run...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh— Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You've been running all this time, haven't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel like I've built up 
a lot more stamina compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Is that so—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Even though you must be busy every day, 
you continue to make an effort without 
fail, don't you?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you run with me 
for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Light footsteps echoed across the morning 
summer sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was at a far gentler pace than what I 
usually saw during training.
choice_data_list: Thanks for playing along with me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all. I can see the scenery 
clearly, so I'm having fun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Besides, for a human's running speed, it 
felt quite fast— and your breathing seemed 
remarkably steady, too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is why— In a way, it also made me 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though I've caught a small 
glimpse of your daily efforts by your 
side."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Once we return to the training camp, 
there is a single flower I wish to give 
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It is a single, round yellow blossom that 
grew large, basking fully in the summer 
sun's blessings."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please decorate the Trainer's room with 
this. —May it bring you a bit of peace of 
mind for the upcoming autumn campaign.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...And I surely wish to gather them for 
you. Those beautiful autumn flowers, as 
well—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Those feelings have swelled up even 
more.)
